chart.purpose: --chart-1..6. Categorical series only; avoids red/amber/green state hues. Single-series charts use the brand accent.

display.purpose: Dashboard monthly-cost figure only. One per screen.

body.purpose: Default copy and table cells; cap prose at 65-75ch.

label.purpose: Stat labels, dt terms and table headers: text-sm muted, sentence case. No uppercase eyebrows.

shadows.name: card-rest
shadows.purpose: Barely-there lift of white cards off paper. Removed entirely in the Crisp variation.

shadows.name: floating-chrome
shadows.purpose: Bottom tab bar, AI panel, popovers: elements that float above the scroll plane.

motion.name: ease-out-quart
motion.purpose: Default easing: count-ups, entrances, list transitions. Settles fast, no bounce.

radiusScale.md: var(--radius) = 0.5rem (0.25rem in Crisp) — buttons, inputs, selects
radiusScale.card: var(--radius-card) = 1.25rem (0.4rem in Crisp) — cards, sheet top corners

components.name: Primary Button
components.description: The single committed action on a screen. Indigo fill, white label.
components.css: .ds-btn-primary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: hsl(243 75% 59%); color: #fff; font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-primary:hover { background: hsl(243 75% 53%); } .ds-btn-primary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(243 75% 59%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Secondary Button
components.description: Lower-emphasis action. Muted fill, ink label.
components.css: .ds-btn-secondary { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 0.5rem; height: 2.5rem; padding: 0 1rem; border: none; border-radius: 0.5rem; background: hsl(220 14% 96%); color: hsl(222 25% 12%); font: 500 0.875rem/1 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; cursor: pointer; transition: background 200ms cubic-bezier(0.16,1,0.3,1); } .ds-btn-secondary:hover { background: hsl(220 14% 92%); } .ds-btn-secondary:focus-visible { outline: 2px solid hsl(243 75% 59%); outline-offset: 2px; }

components.name: Card
components.description: Flat white surface on warm paper. The base container; never nested.
components.html:
Upcoming renewals
Due in the next 30 days, plus anything overdue.
components.css: .ds-card { background: #fff; color: hsl(222 25% 12%); border: 1px solid hsl(220 13% 91%); border-radius: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); padding: 1.5rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-card-title { font-size: 1.125rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; } .ds-card-desc { margin-top: 0.25rem; font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(220 9% 46%); }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: Compact metric tile: quiet label over a tabular value, optional hint. No icon chip.
components.css: .ds-stat { background: #fff; border: 1px solid hsl(220 13% 91%); border-radius: 1.25rem; box-shadow: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / 0.05); padding: 1rem 1.25rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 0.875rem; color: hsl(220 10% 42%); } .ds-stat-value { margin-top: 0.5rem; font-size: 1.875rem; font-weight: 600; letter-spacing: -0.01em; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; } .ds-stat-cur { font-size: 0.5em; font-weight: 500; text-transform: uppercase; color: hsl(220 10% 42%); margin-right: 0.25rem; }

components.name: Segmented Filter Pills
components.description: Rounded-full toggle group for a small fixed filter set. Active pill fills with the brand accent.
components.css: .ds-pills { display: inline-flex; gap: 0.375rem; font-family: 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; } .ds-pill { border: none; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.375rem 0.75rem; font-size: 0.875rem; font-weight: 500; background: hsl(220 14% 96%); color: hsl(220 9% 46%); cursor: pointer; transition: color 200ms, background 200ms; } .ds-pill:hover { color: hsl(222 25% 12%); } .ds-pill-on { background: hsl(243 75% 59%); color: #fff; }

components.name: Trend Pill
components.description: Spending up = destructive tint/ink, down = success, under 0.5% = muted "No change". Arrow + sign carry meaning. Hidden when data can't support a trend.
components.html: +6.9%
components.css: .ds-trend { display: inline-flex; align-items: center; gap: 0.125rem; border-radius: 9999px; padding: 0.125rem 0.5rem; font: 500 0.75rem/1 'Inter Variable', system-ui, sans-serif; font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; background: hsl(0 72% 50% / 0.1); color: hsl(0 72% 42%); }

narrative.overview: The interface of a careful personal accountant, not a trading floor. It holds money information people glance at in short, deliberate sessions, so its job is to be legible and trustworthy at a glance and to disappear otherwise. A warm off-white paper carries flat white cards; a single indigo accent does all the pointing. Minimal and premium means subtraction: tabular, aligned numbers, hierarchy from weight and scale, a palette that stays quiet until something is genuinely time-sensitive. One token system renders across Electron, web PWA, and two layout variations (Default, Crisp).
keyCharacteristics: Warm-neutral paper background, flat white cards, one indigo accent.
Tabular numerals everywhere money lives; numbers never fabricated.
Hierarchy from weight + scale, not borders, stripes, or color.
Calm at rest; color reserved for real urgency.
One token system across Electron, web PWA, and both layout variations.

rules.name: The One Voice Rule
rules.body: A resting screen has exactly one chromatic accent: the brand indigo. Success / warning / destructive are state colors, not decoration.

rules.name: The Dark-Mode Parity Rule
rules.body: A color choice isn't done until it clears AA in light and dark across both variations and a custom brand color.

rules.name: The Tabular Money Rule
rules.body: Any element rendering an amount carries font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums.

rules.name: The Flat-By-Default Rule
rules.body: Surfaces are flat at rest. Real elevation is for elements that genuinely float over content, not ordinary cards.

rules.name: The Fill-vs-Text Rule
rules.body: Bright semantic colors are for fills, dots, icons, and borders; colored text routes through the darker -ink tokens so it clears AA.

dos: Do keep one chromatic accent on a resting screen; let success/amber/red appear only for genuine state.
Do put tabular-nums on every amount and convert all totals to the single display currency.
Do drive all card corners from --radius-card and the nav from its tokens so both variations restyle one structure.
Do pair every status color with an icon, label, or position so it survives color blindness.
Do use the -ink semantic text tokens for colored text; keep bright fills for dots, icons, borders, and badges.
Do give every focusable control a visible focus-visible ring (bottom-nav, pills, chips, swatches all carry one).
Do honor reduced motion globally via MotionConfig reducedMotion=user plus a CSS prefers-reduced-motion reset; the count-up snaps via useReducedMotion.
Do verify muted-ink body text hits 4.5:1 on paper and white card, in light and dark.
donts: Don't reach for the loud crypto/fintech look: no neon gradients, glowing charts, or hype framing.
Don't ship the generic AI-slop SaaS look: no cream/sand saturated body, no tracked-uppercase eyebrow over every section, no identical icon-card grids, no gradient text.
Don't build cluttered gray enterprise density.
Don't add bouncy, elastic, or gamified motion.
Don't use border-left/border-right greater than 1px as a colored accent stripe.
Don't nest cards or lean on heavy shadows to separate ordinary cards.
Don't use a bright semantic color as small text (text-warning ~2.3:1, text-success ~3.6:1 fail AA); use the -ink variant.
Don't fabricate a trend or metric the data can't support; hide it instead.
Don't scale buttons on hover or press; color change only.
Don't use semantic colors decoratively or hex colors outside the token system.
